minutes.headline: Board approved Walmart parking changes and Northfield Rd tree/wall removal; stalled Reservoir Rd project over a frontage rule.
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Planning Board welcomed new Planning Director Stephen Wallace, approved a scenic road alteration and stone-wall/tree removal at 1083 Northfield Road, approved Walmart's parking-lot restriping and pickup-space relocation at 301 Mass Ave, endorsed a revised ANR and found related driveway/storm water changes de minimis for 1083 Northfield Road, and continued the Zero Reservoir Road common driveway and storm water hearings after discovering a lot did not have frontage on the correct street. The board also discussed the draft master plan, the 925 Mass Ave contamination site, quorum concerns about a joint Select Board meeting, and approved a backlog of 2025 minutes.

what_happened.line: The Zero Reservoir Road common driveway and storm water hearings were continued after a lot was found to lack frontage on the correct street.
The board approved a scenic road alteration and stone wall and tree removal at 1083 Northfield Road, with conditions.
The board approved Walmart's site plan for restriping its parking lot and relocating pickup parking at 301 Mass Ave.
The board endorsed a revised ANR plan and found related driveway and storm water changes de minimis at 1083 Northfield Road.
Fewer than a quorum of the board will attend a joint Select Board storm water task force meeting to avoid an open meeting law problem.

why_it_matters: The frontage problem at Zero Reservoir Road means that project's driveway and storm water permits are on hold until the next hearing.
Property line and driveway changes at 1083 Northfield Road and the Walmart lot changes at 301 Mass Ave are now approved, affecting nearby traffic and site conditions.
Contamination at the former 925 Mass Ave gas station site was raised in public comment and is now tied to a working group the board just appointed a member to.
